status: Post-hoc reanalysis; prior 1.5-fold results and named candidates already known; frozen before this new calculation
human_filter: CPM >= 1 in at least 3 of all 9 libraries
normalization: median ratios from genes positive in every included library; geometric recentering
selection: Opposite Model/Control and Treat/Model signs, both absolute log2 ratios >= log2(threshold); Treat strictly between Control and Model; CPM directions and ordering agree; at least 22 of 27 omit-one-per-group configurations retain full-data signs, threshold and ordering
frozen_candidate_family: all original 25; do not replace by candidates retained at another threshold
mouse: Primary 15 unique one-to-one mappings; gene TPM from previous kallisto execution, no FASTQ rerun. Use ctrl, HFD, sess labels; biological mapping unconfirmed. Three means, two signs, strict between rule and all-library TPM<1 flag.
inference: Descriptive only; no DESeq2, p-values, independent validation, or ranking by favorable result
